articles.title: WHBench: Evaluating Frontier LLMs with Expert-in-the-Loop Validation on Women's Health Topics
articles.abstract: Large language models are increasingly used for medical guidance, but women's health remains under-evaluated in benchmark design. We present the Women's Health Benchmark (WHBench), a targeted evaluation suite of 47 expert-crafted scenarios across 10 women's health topics, designed to expose clinically meaningful failure modes including outdated guidelines, unsafe omissions, dosing errors, and equity-related blind spots. We evaluate 22 models using a 23-criterion rubric spanning clinical accuracy, completeness, safety, communication quality, instruction following, equity, uncertainty handling, and guideline adherence, with safety-weighted penalties and server-side score recalculation. Across 3,102 attempted responses (3,100 scored), no model mean performance exceeds 75 percent; the best model reaches 72.1 percent. Even top models show low fully correct rates and substantial variation in harm rates. Inter-rater reliability is moderate at the response label level but high for model ranking, supporting WHBench utility for comparative system evaluation while highlighting the need for expert oversight in clinical deployment. WHBench provides a public, failure-mode-aware benchmark to track safer and more equitable progress in womens health AI.
articles.titleCn: WHBench：基于专家闭环验证评估女性健康领域前沿大语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在医疗指导中的应用日益广泛，但女性健康在基准设计中的评估仍显不足。我们提出了女性健康基准（WHBench），这是一个包含10个女性健康主题下47个由专家精心设计的场景的针对性评估套件，旨在揭示临床上有意义的失效模式，包括过时的指南、不安全的遗漏、剂量错误以及与公平性相关的盲点。我们使用涵盖临床准确性、完整性、安全性、沟通质量、指令遵循、公平性、不确定性处理和指南依从性等23项标准的评分标准对22个模型进行评估，并采用安全加权惩罚和服务器端重新计算分数。在3,102次尝试的回复中（3,100次被评分），没有模型的平均表现超过75%；表现最好的模型达到了72.1%。即使是顶级模型也显示出较低的完全正确率和显著不同的伤害率。在回复标签层面的评分者间信度为中等，但在模型排名上则很高，这表明WHBench可用于比较系统评估，同时也凸显了临床部署中需要专家监督的必要性。WHBench提供了一个公开的、具有失效模式意识的基准，用于追踪女性健康人工智能领域更安全、更公平的进展。

articles.title: Beyond Retrieval: Learning Compact User Representations for Scalable LLM Personalization
articles.abstract: Personalizing large language models requires adapting model behavior to individual users while preserving robustness and deployment-scale efficiency. Existing approaches typically personalize LLMs either at the input level, by retrieving user histories or constructing profile prompts, or at the parameter level, by maintaining user-specific parameter-efficient modules. The former makes personalization sensitive to retrieval quality and prompt design, whereas the latter incurs storage and maintenance costs that grow with the user population. To address these limitations, we propose TAP-PER (Temporal Attentive Prefix for PERsonalization), a prefix-based framework that encodes user preferences as learnable representations, avoiding the serialization of user histories into prompts and replacing heavy per-user adapters with lightweight user-state prefix embeddings. Inspired by personalized recommendation systems, TAP-PER decomposes user modeling into user-state and query-conditioned components, and incorporates temporal signals to capture the evolving nature of user interests. Experiments on six LaMP tasks show that TAP-PER consistently outperforms prompt-based and model-based baselines across classification, rating, and generation settings. Moreover, TAP-PER uses 130x fewer per-user parameters than OPPU and roughly half the total parameter footprint of PER-PCS at the 1,000-user scale, demonstrating scalable personalization without prompt-serialized histories or heavy per-user adapters.
articles.titleCn: 超越检索：学习紧凑用户表示以实现可扩展的大型语言模型个性化
articles.abstractCn: 个性化大型语言模型需要在适应单个用户需求的同时保持模型的鲁棒性和部署规模效率。现有方法通常通过检索用户历史记录或构建用户画像提示来在输入层面个性化大型语言模型，或在参数层面通过维护用户特定的参数高效模块进行个性化。前者使得个性化对检索质量和提示设计敏感，而后者则随着用户数量的增加会产生存储和维护成本。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了TAP-PER（时间注意力前缀用于个性化），这是一种基于前缀的框架，它将用户偏好编码为可学习表示，避免了将用户历史记录序列化为提示，并用轻量级用户状态前缀嵌入取代了重型用户适配器。受个性化推荐系统的启发，TAP-PER将用户建模分解为用户状态和查询条件分量，并引入时间信号以捕捉用户兴趣的演变特性。在六个LaMP任务上的实验表明，TAP-PER在分类、评分和生成设置中始终优于基于提示和基于模型的基线。此外，TAP-PER在1000个用户规模下比OPPU使用130倍的每个用户参数更少，并且大约是PER-PCS总参数足迹的一半，展示了无需提示序列化历史记录或重型每个用户适配器的可扩展个性化能力。

articles.title: ICA Lens: Non-Gaussianity Reveals Interpretable Directions in Language Models
articles.abstract: Finding human-interpretable directions in language-model activations is important for understanding and controlling model behavior. These directions are usually discovered through indirect learning objectives such as sparse reconstruction, but it remains unclear what existing statistical structure distinguishes interpretable directions and whether that structure can be used directly for feature discovery. We find that non-Gaussianity provides such a signature: projection distributions of natural-text residual-stream activations along sparse autoencoder (SAE) decoder directions are substantially more non-Gaussian than those along random directions, with most contexts forming a concentrated background and recurring patterns often occupying one tail. This raises a natural question: if interpretable directions tend to have non-Gaussian projection distributions, can we discover them by searching for non-Gaussian directions directly in activation space, without training another sparse dictionary? To test this hypothesis, we introduce ICA Lens, a practical workflow for efficient discovery, reliable annotation, and faithful evaluation of non-Gaussian directions in LLM residual-stream activations. Across GPT-2 Small, Gemma 2 2B, and Qwen 3.5 9B Base, we find that (1) the recovered non-Gaussian directions capture coherent lexical, syntactic, and semantic patterns under both human and LLM-based evaluation; (2) non-Gaussianity is positively associated with both human-label confidence and automated interpretability; and (3) the resulting coordinates are competitive with SAEs across interpretability, sparse reconstruction, concept prediction, and causal interventions, while fitting in minutes per layer and using 7-43 times less memory. These results show that non-Gaussianity is a direct unsupervised signal for discovering interpretable and useful structure in activations.

articles.titleCn: ICA镜头：非高斯性揭示语言模型中的可解释方向
articles.abstractCn: 在语言模型激活中寻找人类可解释的方向对于理解和控制模型行为至关重要。这些方向通常通过稀疏重建等间接学习目标被发现，但现有统计结构中究竟是什么区分了可解释方向，以及这种结构是否可以直接用于特征发现，目前尚不清楚。我们发现非高斯性提供了这样的特征：自然文本残差流激活在稀疏自动编码器（SAE）解码器方向上的投影分布比随机方向上的投影分布显著更非高斯，大多数上下文形成集中背景，而反复出现的模式通常占据一端。这自然引出一个问题：如果可解释方向倾向于具有非高斯投影分布，我们是否可以直接在激活空间中搜索非高斯方向，而无需训练另一个稀疏字典？为了验证这一假设，我们引入了ICA Lens，这是一个实用的工作流程，用于高效发现、可靠标注和忠实评估语言模型残差流激活中的非高斯方向。在GPT-2 Small、Gemma 2 2B和Qwen 3.5 9B Base上，我们发现（1）恢复的非高斯方向在人类和基于语言模型的评估下都捕获了连贯的词汇、句法和语义模式；（2）非高斯性与人类标签置信度和自动化可解释性呈正相关；（3）所得坐标在可解释性、稀疏重建、概念预测和因果干预方面与SAE具有竞争力，同时每层只需几分钟，且内存使用量减少7-43倍。这些结果表明，非高斯性是发现激活中可解释和有用结构的直接无监督信号。

articles.title: Role Steering of Language Models for Social Simulations
articles.abstract: Social simulations built from language-model agents need role-conditioned behavior that can be checked before agents are placed into a simulated population. We introduce an activation-steering screening workflow for role-conditioned agents: define a role profile, extract a role-specific direction, sweep four steering coefficients, evaluate role-profile alignment, and pass or flag each candidate configuration. On OLMo-3-7B-Instruct, we apply the workflow to a mixed 275-role inventory with 228 role-agnostic questions, GPT-4.1-mini prompted role references, and GPT-4.1-mini judges. We also introduce CastVectors, which receive higher judged role-profile alignment than an assistant-axis directional control from prior persona-vector work, with mean overall scores of 63.2 versus 41.1 across the tested grid. They also preserve high lexical diversity, while the control drops sharply at larger coefficients. The role-level screen is the main contribution: most roles improve as steering increases, but 38 roles decline across all six measured dimensions, showing why simulation builders should choose coefficients per role rather than deploy a uniform high-strength setting. Our code is available at https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors, and the role vectors and evaluation data at https://huggingface.co/datasets/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors.

articles.titleCn: 用于社交模拟的语言模型角色引导
articles.abstractCn: 基于语言模型代理构建的社会模拟需要能够在代理被放置到模拟群体之前进行角色条件行为的检查。我们引入了一种针对角色条件代理的激活引导筛选工作流程：定义角色配置文件，提取特定角色的方向，扫描四个引导系数，评估角色配置文件的匹配度，并对每个候选配置进行通过或标记。在OLMo-3-7B-Instruct上，我们将该工作流程应用于一个包含228个角色无关问题的275角色混合清单，使用GPT-4.1-mini提示角色参考，并由GPT-4.1-mini进行评判。我们还引入了CastVectors，其获得的评判角色配置文件匹配度高于先前的角色向量工作中的辅助轴方向控制，在测试网格中，其平均总体得分为63.2，而控制组为41.1。它们还保持了较高的词汇多样性，而控制组在系数较大时急剧下降。角色级别的筛选是主要贡献：随着引导强度的增加，大多数角色得到改善，但有38个角色在所有六个测量维度上均出现下降，这表明模拟构建者应针对每个角色选择系数，而不是部署统一的强设置。我们的代码可在https://github.com/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors获取，角色向量和评估数据可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/HCAI-Lab-GT/casting-call-vectors获取。

articles.title: Query Timing Produces Opposite Positional Biases Between LLMs and Humans
articles.abstract: Positional biases such as recency and primacy effects have been documented in large language models (LLMs), yet the underlying mechanism by which these models make their evaluations remains poorly understood. Both primacy and recency biases have been observed in human judgments in response to evidence, but recent work suggest that when the listener updates their beliefs - during the presentation of evidence or only at the end - influences the presence of such effects. We investigate whether a similar phenomenon holds for LLMs, finding divergence from human behavior. These biases are more pronounced in newer models compared to their predecessors.

articles.titleCn: 查询时间产生的LLM和人类之间的相反位置偏差
articles.abstractCn: 诸如近因效应和首因效应等位置偏差在大型语言模型（LLMs）中已有记录，但这些模型进行评估的潜在机制仍不为人知。首因效应和近因效应在人类对证据的判断中均有观察到，但近期研究表明，当听众更新其信念——在证据呈现过程中或仅在结束时——会影响此类效应的存在。我们研究了这种现象是否适用于LLMs，发现其行为与人类存在差异。与前辈模型相比，这些偏差在新模型中更为显著。

articles.title: Spike-driven Vision-Language-Action Model
articles.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bridge multimodal understanding and robotic control, advancing the dominant paradigm for embodied intelligence. However, most existing models rely on large Transformers, whose latency and energy costs hinder deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Through sparse event-driven computation, spiking neural networks offer a promising paradigm for high-performance and energy-efficient computing. Here, we propose the first Spike-driven VLA framework enabling end-to-end direct training for robotic manipulation, which mainly comprises three core components. First, we develop spiking visual and instruction encoders for multimodal perception, encoding visual observations and language instructions into sparse, reliable spike representations for subsequent cross-modal fusion. Then, we introduce Multi-Winner Spike Fusion for instruction-guided scene understanding, using bidirectional top-$k$ winner-take-all spike routing to suppress background interference and yield fused memory. Finally, we propose a Spike Action Chunking Transformer that incorporates spiking cross-attention over the fused memory and the current robot state, enabling efficient end-to-end generation of continuous action chunks for robotic control. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and Meta-World demonstrate that Spike-driven VLA achieves competitive performance with fewer parameters and lower estimated inference energy than conventional VLA models. This work establishes a foundational framework for neuromorphic VLA modeling, paving the way for future advances in resource-efficient embodied intelligence.
articles.titleCn: 基于脉冲的视觉-语言-行动模型
articles.abstractCn: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型连接多模态理解和机器人控制，推动了具身智能的主流范式。然而，现有大多数模型依赖大型Transformer，其延迟和能耗成本阻碍了在资源受限平台上的部署。通过稀疏事件驱动计算，脉冲神经网络为高性能和节能计算提供了有前景的范式。在此，我们提出了首个脉冲驱动的VLA框架，支持机器人操作的端到端直接训练，主要包含三个核心组件。首先，我们开发了脉冲视觉和指令编码器，用于多模态感知，将视觉观测和语言指令编码为稀疏、可靠的脉冲表示，以供后续跨模态融合。其次，我们引入了多赢家脉冲融合，用于指令引导的场景理解，采用双向top-k赢家通吃脉冲路由来抑制背景干扰并产生融合记忆。最后，我们提出了脉冲动作分块Transformer，该Transformer结合了跨融合记忆和当前机器人状态的脉冲交叉注意力，实现高效端到端的连续动作分块生成，用于机器人控制。在LIBERO和Meta-World上的大量实验表明，脉冲驱动的VLA在参数更少、估计推理能耗更低的情况下，实现了与传统VLA模型具有竞争力的性能。这项工作为神经形态VLA建模建立了基础框架，为未来资源高效的具身智能发展铺平了道路。

articles.title: Multi-Estimate Elicitation Does Not Uniformly Debias Language Model Judgments
articles.abstract: Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV) is a task- and model-dependent output protocol: repairing format does not guarantee better posterior accuracy, and requesting weights differs from reweighting an already generated candidate set. Across 31,672 planned/admitted evaluation units and 32,184 planned/admitted calls (excluding retries), we connect a frozen six-configuration cohort to exploratory scale/organization experiments and two independently preregistered post-cohort formal suites. Stage 1 retains 11 directional confirmations among 45 frozen tests; only increased post-outcome confirmation error on gpt-oss-120b exceeds its SESOI. P1 completes 1,920 terminal units: smaller response scales sharply lower operational string-match rates but increase Bayesian error. P2 completes 2,560 calls and 2,048 units: eliciting weights raises three errors by +2.75 / +2.05 / +3.88 pp, while within-generation weighting changes them by only -0.052 / -0.049 / -0.067 pp, a 42x-58x magnitude difference. Unconstrained joint generation with post-hoc normalization offers a local normalized-error improvement for three exhaustive options, without confirmed accuracy improvement. These results distinguish format validity, numerical accuracy and psychological susceptibility; a descriptive three-class behavioral spectrum organizes heterogeneity without identifying internal causes. Materials: https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies

articles.titleCn: 多估计提取并不能统一消除语言模型判断的偏差
articles.abstractCn: 多候选语言化（MCV）是一项任务和模型相关的输出协议：修复格式并不能保证更好的后验准确率，而请求权重与重新加权已生成的候选集有所不同。在31,672个计划/录取的评估单元和32,184个计划/录取的通话（不包括重试）中，我们将一个冻结的六配置队列连接到探索性规模/组织实验和两个独立预先注册的队列后正式套件。第一阶段在45个冻结测试中保留了11个方向性确认；只有gpt-oss-120b的后结果确认错误增加超过了其SESOI。P1完成了1,920个终端单元：较小的响应规模急剧降低了操作字符串匹配率，但增加了贝叶斯误差。P2完成了2,560个通话和2,048个单元：获取权重使误差增加了+2.75 / +2.05 / +3.88 pp，而代内权重变化仅使误差减少了-0.052 / -0.049 / -0.067 pp，幅度差异为42x-58x。无约束联合生成结合事后归一化，为三种穷举选项提供了局部归一化误差改进，但未确认准确率改进。这些结果区分了格式有效性、数值准确性和心理易感性；一个描述性的三分类行为谱系组织了异质性，但并未识别内部原因。材料：https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies

articles.title: Can AI Judge You? An Empirical Audit of Deployment Readiness in LLM-assisted Hiring Systems
articles.abstract: Delegating resume screening to large language models (LLMs) requires organizations to establish whether they can distinguish candidates by relevant qualifications while allowing only authorized users to change screening rules or approve exceptions. To this end, we develop a system architecture that separates candidate evidence, evaluation, permission controls, and assessment record, and empirically examine two complementary dimensions of its deployment readiness. First, we assess its operational readiness on four LLMs using a controlled experiment on 210 resumes across 14 job roles and six decision interfaces. Second, we assess its compliance readiness by testing how it handles unauthorized user requests and instructions embedded in resumes. We find that operational performance depends on the choice of evaluation interface: scalar scores generally distinguish qualification changes better than simple pass/fail judgments, while comparative judgments are sensitive to presentation order. Explicit permission rules and separation of resume content from instructions reduce unauthorized compliance, to a varying degree of effectiveness across LLMs and usage contexts. Finally, we find that LLM evaluators often diverge between their decisions and offered justifications. Going beyond simply evaluating LLMs for hiring tasks, our framework supports an audit of a fully configured resume evaluation system to enable its deployment decision.
articles.titleCn: AI能评判你吗？LLM辅助招聘系统部署准备情况的经验性审计
articles.abstractCn: 将简历筛选工作委托给大型语言模型（LLM）需要组织建立一套机制，确保模型能够根据相关资质区分候选人，同时仅允许授权用户修改筛选规则或批准例外情况。为此，我们设计了一种系统架构，将候选人证据、评估过程、权限控制和评估记录进行分离，并通过实证研究考察其部署准备情况的两个互补维度。首先，我们通过在14个职位角色和6个决策界面的210份简历上进行的受控实验，评估该系统在四种LLM上的操作准备情况。其次，我们通过测试系统如何处理简历中嵌入的非授权用户请求和指令，评估其合规准备情况。我们发现，操作性能取决于评估界面的选择：标量评分通常比简单的通过/失败判断更能区分资质变化，而比较性判断则对呈现顺序敏感。明确的权限规则以及将简历内容与指令分离，能够在不同LLM和使用场景下以不同程度的有效性减少非授权合规。最后，我们发现LLM评估者在其决策和提供的理由之间往往存在分歧。超越仅仅评估LLM在招聘任务中的表现，我们的框架支持对完全配置好的简历评估系统进行审计，以支持其部署决策。

articles.title: SkillBuffBench: Measuring What Agent Skills Contribute across Harnesses, Models, Skill Access Modes and Memory
articles.abstract: Agent Skills, file-based packages of procedural knowledge that a coding agent can discover and load on demand, are now shipped by every major agent harness, yet the evidence for how much they help comes almost entirely from settings in which the right Skill is hand-picked for the task and the agent starts from a blank slate. Neither holds in deployment, where an agent chooses from whatever library happens to be installed and frequently carries memory from earlier work. We present SkillBuffBench, a benchmark and paired evaluation protocol that treats Skill access as a three-level factor (no Skill, a curated Skill, and automatic invocation from an installed library), crosses it with memory (off and on), with four agent harnesses and with multiple models (the state-of-the-art proprietary models from Anthropic, Google and OpenAI, and the state-of-the-art open-weight models from Chinese providers), every model being run under every harness, and evaluates the result on research tasks contributed by domain experts together with the Skills they use, currently in materials science and biology, with the suite extended on a rolling basis. Every run is marked by a deterministic verifier; uncertainty is reported with a paired, task-level bootstrap; and cost, agent rounds and wall-clock time are reported alongside the score rather than folded into it. This version of the paper describes the design of the benchmark, its evaluation protocol and its current tasks and Skills. The evaluation is in progress: results will be added once the runs are complete, and the task suite, results and analysis will continue to be updated on a rolling basis.

articles.titleCn: 技能增强工作台：衡量代理技能在不同应用、模型、技能访问模式和内存中的贡献
articles.abstractCn: 代理技能，即编码代理可按需发现和加载的程序化知识文件包，现已成为每个主要代理框架的标准配置，但关于它们实际效果的证据几乎完全来自那些为任务精心挑选了合适技能且代理从空白状态开始的场景。然而在部署环境中，这些条件并不成立，代理会从已安装的库中选择技能，且频繁携带早期工作的记忆。我们提出了SkillBuffBench，这是一个基准测试和配对评估协议，将技能访问视为一个三级因素（无技能、精选技能和自动调用已安装库），并将其与记忆（开启和关闭）相结合，涵盖四个代理框架，以及来自Anthropic、Google和OpenAI的当前最先进的专有模型，和来自中国提供商的当前最先进的开放权重模型，每个模型都在每个框架下运行，并使用领域专家贡献的研究任务及其使用的技能进行评估，目前涵盖材料科学和生物学，且该套件将滚动扩展。每次运行都由确定性验证器标记；不确定性通过配对的任务级引导程序报告；成本、代理轮次和墙上时间将与分数一起报告，而不是合并到分数中。本文的这一版本描述了基准测试的设计、其评估协议及其当前的任务和技能。评估正在进行中：一旦运行完成，将添加结果，任务套件、结果和分析将继续滚动更新。

articles.title: GauntletScore: Auditable Fact-Checking That Matches the Best Published Checkers on LLM-AggreFact
articles.abstract: Checking whether a generated sentence is supported by its source document is a standard safeguard for AI-written text, and the strongest published checkers are single models. We describe GauntletScore, an evidence engine whose few rules and thresholds were set on the benchmark's development split. It puts typed questions to independent readers from different providers and records each answer as a measurement in an evidence ledger. It combines the measurements with a fixed Bayesian rule that counts a contradiction only when two readers agree. On the full LLM-AggreFact test split (29,320 claims across 11 datasets), following the leaderboard's approach, GauntletScore achieves 79.51 balanced accuracy, above every average published on the leaderboard as of 15 November 2026. That places it level with the best of them, nimble-v4-max (79.45 from its published dataset scores; the engine's 95% interval, 78.47 to 80.53, contains it). On the same claims it beats two of its three readers used alone (Readers A and B) by 1.66 and 2.17 points (95% intervals 0.80 to 2.53 and 1.29 to 3.06). Without AggreFact-CNN, described below, the leads are 0.90 and 1.32 and both intervals stay above zero. The engine also records the evidence behind every verdict, which a single model does not. Its largest margin is on full-length news articles checked against multi-sentence summaries (AggreFact-CNN), a format that resembles much regulated writing. There it scores 76.45, the best on the leaderboard, against 70.1 for the next best and 63.9 to 67.8 for the six systems with the highest averages. The test split was run once, on an engine frozen before the first test claim, under a stopping plan committed in advance. We release per-claim predictions and the scoring script.

articles.titleCn: Gauntlet评分：可审计的事实核查，与LLM-AggreFact上最佳已发布核查器相匹配
articles.abstractCn: 验证生成的句子是否得到其源文档的支持是AI生成文本的标准安全措施，而最强的已发布检查器是单一模型。我们描述了GauntletScore，一个证据引擎，其少量规则和阈值是在基准测试的开发拆分数据上设定的。它向来自不同提供者的独立读者提出类型化问题，并将每个答案记录为证据账本中的一个测量值。它将测量值与一个固定的贝叶斯规则相结合，该规则仅在两个读者同意时才计算矛盾。在完整的LLM-AggreFact测试拆分数据（跨越11个数据集的29,320个声明）上，遵循排行榜的方法，GauntletScore达到了79.51的平衡精度，高于截至2026年11月15日排行榜上所有已发布的平均值。这使其与最佳水平相当，nimble-v4-max（其发布数据集得分为79.45；引擎的95%区间为78.47至80.53，包含该值）。在相同的声明上，它单独使用的三个读者中的两个（读者A和读者B）分别领先1.66和2.17分（95%区间为0.80至2.53和1.29至3.06）。如果没有下面描述的AggreFact-CNN，领先优势分别为0.90和1.32，且两个区间均保持为正。该引擎还记录了每个裁决背后的证据，而单一模型则不记录。其最大优势在于对完整长度的新闻文章与多句摘要的检查（AggreFact-CNN），这种格式类似于大量受监管的写作。在那里它得分为76.45，是排行榜上的最佳成绩，而次优成绩为70.1，六个平均最高系统分别为63.9至67.8。测试拆分数据仅运行一次，在引擎冻结在第一个测试声明之前，根据预先承诺的停止计划进行。我们发布了每个声明的预测结果和评分脚本。

articles.title: Thinking Harder Doesn't Lead to Better Choices: Reasoning Effort Increases the Confidence but Not the Correctness of LLM Shopping Agents
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous shopping agents that process multimodal product listings (consisting of visual and text data) and recommend purchases on behalf of consumers. Naturally, one might assume that models with more thinking power would make higher-quality purchasing decisions. To test this belief, we ask two questions about such agents: does asking a model to think harder make it choose better products, and does the confidence it reports tell us the likelihood it may be wrong? We benchmark ten frontier models on three product-choice benchmarks built from WebShop, Amazon's SQID and Wayfair's WANDS platforms to see if LLMs with more thinking power actually make better-quality product purchase decisions. Across all three benchmarks, we found that increasing the thinking effort does not increase decision quality in a statistically meaningful way. The same change in thinking effort raises stated confidence at a statistically significant level, so extra thinking buys confidence rather than correctness. We also measure the calibration of these models (how well their reported confidence percentage matches their true correctness percentage) in these tasks and show that most models are not well-calibrated at every effort level. We also find that errors are strongly shared: when one model errs in a task, several others tend to err on that same task. Furthermore, on tasks where several models all err, a large number of them pick the same wrong product.
articles.titleCn: 思考更深入并不导致更好的选择：推理努力会增加大型语言模型购物代理的信心，但不会增加其正确性
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正越来越多地被部署为自主购物代理，它们处理包含视觉和文本数据的多模态产品列表，并代表消费者进行购买推荐。自然地，人们可能会假设思考能力更强的模型会做出更高质量的购买决策。为了验证这一信念，我们针对这类代理提出了两个问题：让模型思考更深入是否能让它选择更好的产品，以及它报告的置信度是否反映了其可能出错的可能性？我们在基于WebShop、亚马逊SQID和Wayfair WANDS平台构建的三个产品选择基准上对十种前沿模型进行了基准测试，以检验思考能力更强的LLM是否真的能做出更高质量的产品购买决策。在所有三个基准测试中，我们发现增加思考投入并不能以统计上有意义的方式提高决策质量。同样的思考投入变化会以统计上显著的方式提高报告置信度，因此额外的思考买来的更多是置信度而非正确性。我们还测量了这些模型在这些任务中的校准度（其报告置信百分比与真实正确百分比的一致程度），并表明大多数模型在所有投入水平上校准度不佳。我们还发现错误具有强相关性：当一个模型在某个任务中出错时，其他几个模型也倾向于在该任务中出错。此外，在多个模型都出错的任务中，它们中有大量模型选择了同一个错误的产品。

articles.title: RLDE: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Interpretable Iterative Document Editing
articles.abstract: Improving the quality, clarity, and flow of long documents remains a challenging problem in NLP, as human editing typically occurs through iterative refinement rather than a single-pass rewrite. Most existing automated systems act as black-box generators or rely on supervised learning, limiting interpretability and failing to capture the sequential nature of revisions. In this paper, we propose RLDE, an automated end-to-end metric-driven RL framework that formulates document revision as a reference-free MDP problem (unsupervised with respect to paired document-revision targets). Working with a limited action space (NOOP, INSERT, DELETE, REPLACE), RLDE leverages Pointer Networks for dynamic span selection at the token level and sends generative actions to the frozen BART-base model to obtain context-aware suggestions. PPO agents learn to optimize a multi-objective reward function based on readability, perplexity, and grammar metrics with the help of a novel SBERT-based Semantic Preservation Penalty constraint to avoid deletion degeneracy. Evaluations on the BEA-2019 dataset showed statistically significant results (p < 0.01) across all metrics, where Flesch Reading Ease increased from 49.8 to 59.4, perplexity decreased from 63.7 to 39.8, while preserving 93% of semantic information. When compared to Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompt-engineered models like GPT-4 and LLaMA-2, RLDE shows high performance at a very low computational inference cost. Moreover, the quality of edits generated by RLDE has been verified via human evaluations, scoring 4.9/5 for meaning preservation and 4.4/5 for edit quality.
articles.titleCn: RLDE：一个用于可解释迭代文档编辑的强化学习框架
articles.abstractCn: 提升长文档的质量、清晰度和流畅性仍然是自然语言处理领域的一项挑战，因为人类编辑通常通过迭代优化而非单次重写进行。大多数现有自动化系统要么充当黑盒生成器，要么依赖监督学习，这限制了可解释性并无法捕捉修订的序列特性。在本文中，我们提出了RLDE，一个端到端的、基于指标的强化学习框架，将文档修订问题形式化为无参考的马尔可夫决策过程（相对于成对文档-修订目标而言是无监督的）。在有限动作空间（NOOP、INSERT、DELETE、REPLACE）的配合下，RLDE利用指针网络在词元级别进行动态跨度选择，并将生成动作发送给冻结的BART-base模型以获取上下文感知建议。PPO代理在可读性、困惑度和语法指标的多目标奖励函数的帮助下进行优化，并借助基于SBERT的新型语义保留惩罚约束来避免删除退化。在BEA-2019数据集上的评估显示，所有指标均取得了统计学上显著的成果（p < 0.01），其中Flesch阅读易度从49.8提升至59.4，困惑度从63.7降至39.8，同时保留了93%的语义信息。与GPT-4和LLaMA-2等通过思维链提示工程构建的模型相比，RLDE在极低的计算推理成本下展现出高性能。此外，RLDE生成的修订质量已通过人工评估验证，在语义保留方面得分为4.9/5，在修订质量方面得分为4.4/5。

articles.title: Beyond Acuity Accuracy: A Multidimensional Framework for Evaluating Patient-Facing Emergency Triage AI Tools
articles.abstract: Patient-facing AI triage tools may support care-seeking and emergency department prioritization, but require evaluation beyond acuity accuracy alone. We developed SAFE-Triage, a framework integrating human review, automated metrics, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and simulation testing across clinical performance, patient interaction, and clinician-facing summary quality. We applied SAFE-Triage to 40 MIMIC-IV-derived emergency vignettes and a 10,030-case acuity analysis comparing prompted LLM triage (PLT) with rule-augmented prompted LLM triage (rPLT). PLT achieved higher emergency severity index (ESI) accuracy (57.5% vs 42.8%, $P < 0.001$), lower undertriage (13.1% vs 29.8%, $P < 0.001$), and higher clinician ratings across all domains. rPLT produced shorter and more stable outputs with higher automated readability scores. SAFE-Triage identified trade-offs between acuity accuracy, undertriage risk, communication quality, readability, and summary quality, supporting pre-deployment refinement and ongoing monitoring by showing where triage tools are efficient, need improvement, or need clinician oversight.

articles.titleCn: 超越精准性：评估面向患者的急诊分诊人工智能工具的多维度框架
articles.abstractCn: 面向患者的AI分诊工具可能有助于寻求医疗帮助和急诊科优先级排序，但需要超越仅关注严重程度准确性的评估。我们开发了SAFE-Triage框架，该框架整合了人工审核、自动化指标、LLM作为评判者评估以及跨临床表现、患者互动和面向临床医生的摘要质量进行的模拟测试。我们将SAFE-Triage应用于40个MIMIC-IV衍生的急诊案例片段，以及一个包含10,030个案例的严重程度分析，比较了提示LLM分诊（PLT）与规则增强提示LLM分诊（rPLT）。PLT实现了更高的急诊严重程度指数（ESI）准确性（57.5% vs 42.8%，$P < 0.001$）、更低的低估分诊率（13.1% vs 29.8%，$P < 0.001$）以及所有领域的更高临床医生评分。rPLT产生了更短且更稳定的输出，并具有更高的自动化可读性评分。SAFE-Triage识别了严重程度准确性、低估分诊风险、沟通质量、可读性和摘要质量之间的权衡，通过展示分诊工具在哪些方面高效、需要改进或需要临床医生监督，支持了部署前的优化和持续监测。

articles.title: Weight-Space Programming Doesn't Need Transformers
articles.abstract: Standard neural architectures such as the Transformer were chosen because they train well with gradient descent and run fast on GPUs. In weight-space programming, a large language model (LLM) writes target weights by hand without gradient-based training, so those reasons no longer apply. Should we keep the Transformer? Given minimal guidance, ten labeled examples, and a sandbox, mainly on multiple-choice questions, we task three frontier LLMs with either generating the weights of a fixed architecture or designing the architecture themselves. When free to design, all three compile plain-text facts into a sparse table queried by a fixed procedure, reaching up to 54.4% test accuracy. An LLM-designed model achieves higher test accuracy than the most accurate released Transformer that the same LLM wrote while using about 1,800x fewer parameters. Without gradients, they choose a table, in which the LLM can state what each weight means and can find and rewrite a wrong one. Each wrong answer points to one row, and removing a row changes about one other answer. From this, we propose an associative-memory-based model up to 17x faster on GPUs than a same-sized Transformer. We also test pretrained weights, other benchmarks, and tasks where models generate answers. Pretrained LLMs remain more accurate; the claim concerns which structure to build when writing weights.
articles.titleCn: 权重空间编程不需要Transformer
articles.abstractCn: 我们选择了标准神经架构，如Transformer，因为它们能够通过梯度下降很好地训练，并且在GPU上运行速度快。在权重空间编程中，大型语言模型（LLM）通过手动编写目标权重，而不依赖基于梯度的训练，因此这些原因不再适用。我们应该保留Transformer吗？在有限的指导下，通过十个标记示例和一个沙盒环境，主要针对多项选择题，我们让三个前沿LLM执行生成固定架构的权重或自行设计架构的任务。在自由设计的情况下，所有三个模型将纯文本事实编译成一个稀疏表，并通过固定程序查询，达到高达54.4%的测试准确率。由LLM设计的模型比同一LLM编写的最准确的已发布Transformer模型在参数数量减少约1800倍的情况下，实现了更高的测试准确率。没有梯度的情况下，它们选择一个表，其中LLM可以说明每个权重代表的意义，并可以找到并重写错误的权重。每个错误答案都指向一行，移除一行会改变大约一个其他答案。基于此，我们提出了一种基于联想存储的模型，其GPU运行速度比同等规模的Transformer快17倍。我们还测试了预训练权重、其他基准测试以及模型生成答案的任务。预训练LLM仍然更准确；争议在于编写权重时应构建哪种结构。

articles.title: What MoE Routing Controls: Causal Interventions on Expert Trajectories
articles.abstract: In mixture-of-experts (MoE) language models, a token is routed to a sequence of experts across layers. We investigate how forcing tokens onto chosen expert paths influences model behavior. We build a target path from the experts that a concept's or role's tokens most often use, and we add a fixed bias to each target expert's router logit during generation to steer the token toward this expert path. We study two kinds of targets. Format targets concern the form of the output, and concept targets concern its topic. In Qwen3-30B-A3B, we show that steering a format path changes the text the model writes. We also show that steering a concept path shifts the model's next-token probabilities toward the concept, even when the path is built in another language, yet this shift has little effect on the generated text. We investigate why formats reach the text but concepts do not by steering only part of the generation, and find evidence that a format, once started, reinforces itself. We show that the concepts religion and money steer most strongly, and that the effect is concentrated in the middle layers. We attempt to explain why the strength of the effect varies by concept through an analysis of embedding distinctiveness and word frequency.
articles.titleCn: 什么是MoE路由控制：对专家轨迹的因果干预
articles.abstractCn: 在专家混合（MoE）语言模型中，一个标记会跨层路由到一系列专家。我们研究了强制标记选择特定专家路径如何影响模型行为。我们从概念或角色的标记最常使用的专家构建目标路径，并在生成过程中为每个目标专家的路由日志添加固定偏差，以引导标记朝向该专家路径。我们研究了两种目标类型：格式目标和概念目标。在Qwen3-30B-A3B模型中，我们证明引导格式路径会改变模型生成的文本。我们还证明，即使路径是在另一种语言中构建的，引导概念路径也会使模型的下一个标记概率向该概念偏移，但这种偏移对生成的文本影响甚微。我们通过仅引导生成过程的一部分来研究为什么格式能够影响文本而概念不能，并发现证据表明一旦格式开始，它会自我强化。我们证明宗教和金钱是引导效果最强的概念，并且这种效果集中在中间层。我们通过分析嵌入的独特性和词频来尝试解释为什么不同概念的效果强度存在差异。

articles.title: Long-Context Generation Is a Sampling Problem (When You Turn Up the Heat)
articles.abstract: Open-weight language models are widely observed to get worse the longer they generate. Often, attempts to fix this involve more training. At high temperature, The sampler, i.e. the rule that picks the next token out of the model's probabilities, decides whether long and agentic generation survives and/or thrives. We test 29 open-weight models from 1B to 122B parameters on ten established benchmarks plus needle retrieval out to one million tokens, covering SWE-bench Verified coding agents, long chain-of-thought reasoning, long-form writing, long structured output and long-context reading. Samplers that keep their pool of candidate tokens small and steady as temperature rises don't lose accuracy. Samplers that let in low-probability tokens fall apart. At temperature 2, coding agents running top-p, top-k or Top-H resolve 0 of 100 GitHub issues, while the same agents running top-nsigma resolve 46 to 62 and win every issue the two samplers disagree on, on three Qwen3.5 models. Over all benchmarks top-nsigma keeps a median 100% of its temperature-1 score where top-p keeps 26%. Counting how many tokens each sampler lets through explains why. In one Llama-3.1-8B story, going from temperature 1 to 2 grows top-p's pool from 4 tokens to 51,845 while top-nsigma stays at 3. Across 133 combinations of sampler setting and temperature, the typical pool size predicts judged quality (Spearman correlation of -0.77), and when we pick the pool at temperature 1 and only apply temperature afterwards, Top-H, min-p and p-less stop collapsing. At the default temperature of 1 most samplers perform about the same, We release all code and data to the public.
articles.comment: 10 pages, accepted to the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
articles.titleCn: 长上下文生成是一个采样问题（当你提高温度时）
articles.abstractCn: 开放权重语言模型普遍存在生成内容越长表现越差的问题。通常，试图解决这个问题的方法是增加训练量。在高温下，采样器（即从模型概率中选择下一个词的规则）决定了长文本和具有自主性的生成是否能存活和/或繁荣。我们测试了29个参数量从1B到122B的开放权重模型，在十个既定基准测试外加一百万个token的针头检索任务上，涵盖SWE-bench验证编码代理、长链式思维推理、长文本写作、长结构化输出和长上下文阅读。当温度升高时，保持候选词池大小和稳定性的采样器不会丢失精度。而允许低概率词进入的采样器则会出现崩溃。在温度为2时，使用top-p、top-k或Top-H的编码代理在100个GitHub问题上解决率为0，而使用top-nsigma的代理则解决了46到62个问题，并在三个Qwen3.5模型上赢得了两个采样器存在分歧的所有问题。在所有基准测试中，top-nsigma保持了温度-1分数的中位数100%，而top-p只保持了26%。统计每个采样器允许通过的token数量解释了原因。在一个Llama-3.1-8B的故事中，从温度1增加到2时，top-p的词池从4个词扩展到51,845个词，而top-nsigma保持在3个词。在133种采样器设置和温度组合中，典型池大小预测了评判质量（Spearman相关系数为-0.77），当我们选择温度1时的池，并仅在此后应用温度时，Top-H、min-p和p-less停止崩溃。在默认温度1下，大多数采样器的表现大致相同，我们将所有代码和数据公开。

articles.title: What RL on Expert-Built Tasks Teaches Nemotron 3.5 Super
articles.abstract: We post-train NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Super (120B total, 12B active parameters) with reinforcement learning (RL) on five expert-built task datasets, one at a time: real-world software engineering, complex constraints, long-horizon tool use, professional chart understanding and enterprise document reasoning. Each run trains a fresh rank-32 LoRA adapter with CISPO on Tinker, with no supervised stage, and each adapter is compared with the base model on the same tasks, harness and settings. On twelve headline benchmarks, eight built by other groups and four by Surge AI, the gains range from +4.5 points on IFBench to +13.8 on GDP_pdf, which rises from 10.4% to 24.2%; SWE-bench Pro V2 rises from 86.9% to 92.1%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 63.9% to 70.3%, MultiChallenge from 58.3% to 66.6%, AutomationBench from 14.8% to 27.5% and Chartography from 39.4% to 50.6%. The document adapter, trained without API tools, also gains +8.0 points on AutomationBench. In attempts read side by side with the base model's on tasks each adapter newly solves, the base model's failures recur in a few modes, and each adapter does more often what the base model missed: the tool-use adapter finds the data and the rules before acting, the coding adapter writes its own test or scratch files on SWE-bench Pro V2, the constraints adapter carries earlier turns into its answers, the chart adapter measures the marks in code, and the document adapter reads AutomationBench's spreadsheets.
articles.titleCn: 在专家构建的任务上进行的强化学习教会了Nemotron 3.5超级能力
articles.abstractCn: 我们使用强化学习（RL）在五个由专家构建的任务数据集上对NVIDIA的Nemotron 3.5 Super（总参数量120B，激活参数量12B）进行后训练：现实世界软件工程、复杂约束、长时程工具使用、专业图表理解和企业文档推理。每次运行都在Tinker上使用CISPO训练一个新的秩32 LoRA适配器，没有监督阶段，并将每个适配器与在同一任务、 harness和设置下的基础模型进行比较。在十二个主要基准测试中，其中八个由其他团队构建，四个由Surge AI构建，增益范围从IFBench的+4.5分到GDP_pdf的+13.8分，从10.4%提升到24.2%；SWE-bench Pro V2从86.9%提升到92.1%，Terminal-Bench 2.1从63.9%提升到70.3%，MultiChallenge从58.3%提升到66.6%，AutomationBench从14.8%提升到27.5%，Chartography从39.4%提升到50.6%。未经API工具训练的文档适配器在AutomationBench上也获得了+8.0分的提升。在尝试与基础模型逐行对比每个适配器新解决的任务时，基础模型的失败在某些模式下会重复出现，而每个适配器更频繁地完成了基础模型遗漏的工作：工具使用适配器在行动前找到数据和规则，编码适配器在SWE-bench Pro V2上编写自己的测试或草稿文件，约束适配器将早期的对话内容融入其答案，图表适配器在代码中测量标记，文档适配器读取AutomationBench的电子表格。

articles.title: Is 4-Bit Quantization More Than Noise to a Chat Model's Safety Behaviour? Attributing Behavioural Shifts with Matched Perturbations
articles.abstract: Chat models on phones and laptops are usually 4-bit copies of the model that was evaluated, and audits of such copies disagree about what quantization does to refusal. A 4-bit build is one of many weight perturbations of the same size, so a change in its behaviour could come from its specific rounding error or from any perturbation that large. In a pre-registered study of three 3-4B chat models, with paired tests, blind human labels and an 8-bit null, we find two 4-bit shifts of opposite sign: with a compliant reply prefilled, Qwen2.5-3B continues into harmful content more often, and on held-out jailbreaks Llama-3.2-3B complies 10.3 points less often. Matched perturbations separate the two. Shuffled and Gaussian versions of the error average close to zero, while scaling the real error, from its mirror image to twice its size, changes behaviour near-linearly. At half the real error, Llama's likelihood is almost unchanged, yet it already complies 5.8 points less often, and llama.cpp's Q4_K_M, at the same bits per weight, moves neither model. Refusal under 4-bit quantization depends on the specific rounding error, not on bits per weight or likelihood, so each build has to be compared with its original.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 4 figures. Code and labels: https://github.com/egekaya1/qrefusal
articles.titleCn: 四比特量化是否对聊天模型的Safety行为产生了超出噪声的影响？通过匹配扰动来归因行为变化
articles.abstractCn: 手机和笔记本电脑上的聊天模型通常是经过评估的模型的4位副本，对这些副本的审计结果对于量化对拒绝行为的影响存在分歧。4位构建是同等规模权重扰动中的一种，因此其行为变化可能来自其特定的舍入误差，也可能来自任何同等规模的扰动。在一项关于三个3-4B聊天模型的预注册研究中，采用配对测试、盲人人工标记和8位空白对照，我们发现存在两个符号相反的4位变化：当预填充合规回复时，Qwen2.5-3B更频繁地进入有害内容，而在保留的越狱测试中，Llama-3.2-3B的合规率降低了10.3个百分点。匹配的扰动可以区分这两种情况。打乱和高斯化的误差接近于零，而将实际误差从其镜像放大到两倍大小，行为变化近似线性。实际误差的一半，Llama的几率几乎未变，但它已经降低了5.8个百分点的合规率，而lla.cpp的Q4_K_M在相同每权重位数下，两个模型均未发生变化。在4位量化下，拒绝行为取决于特定的舍入误差，而不是每权重的位数或几率，因此每个构建都必须与其原始版本进行比较。

articles.title: From Imperfective Paradox to Moorean Absurdity: Single-Chain Reasoning Lock-In and Multi-Candidate Verbalization Across Aspectual and Pragmatic Ambiguity
articles.abstract: Natural language entailment and coherence judgments often depend on whether an event merely occurred, reached a telic culmination, satisfied a plan, or was evaluated under multiple pragmatic standards. We test observable consequences of the single-chain premature lock-in hypothesis across four preregistered, sealed formal experiments on Qwen3-8B-Q8_0 (16,640 formal units, temperature=0.0): 15 of 16 hypothesis slots retain confirmatory status (12 rejecting H0 under within-experiment Holm control at alpha_fam=0.05; E3_H3 demoted to descriptive status). In Experiment 1, Direct-CoT vs. MCU differs by 25.00 pp on telic high-confidence completion (Holm p=1.31239e-05), while NLI-CoT collapses by -91.25 pp on uninterrupted atelic items (Holm p=1.81805e-21). Multi-Candidate Verbalization (MCV) elicits K=5 weighted estimates in one call, separating the prompt from unweighted (MCU) and self-weighted (MCW) readouts. Mandarin (E2) and English (E3) expose an Interruption-Anchored Realis Paradox under NLI-CoT. In Experiment 4, MCU-CF raises perceived coherence on implicit Moorean sentences by 26.64 pp over Direct-CoT (Holm p=0.0006), alongside Direct-CF - Direct-CoT = 29.15 pp and MCU-CoT - Direct-CoT = 17.31 pp. A 1,800-call OpenAI ablation and a stage="dev" P16.7 cross-model extension (4,240 planned/collected units across five external models: 4,222 valid, 18 format-missing, 0 transport-missing; <2% missing per slice; OpenAI gpt-4o-mini at top_logprobs=20 achieves 1,000/1,000 valid units) show that discrete NLI-CoT and scalar Direct-CoT judgments dissociate across models. Confirmatory effects concern observable prompt-and-readout protocols; internal premature lock-in remains a hypothesis. All code, stimuli, preregistered analysis plans, and verification tools are available at https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies.

articles.titleCn: 从非完成时悖论到摩尔式荒谬：单链推理锁定与跨体貌及语用模糊性的多候选项语言化
articles.abstractCn: 自然语言蕴涵和连贯性判断往往取决于事件是否仅仅发生、达到目的性终结、满足计划或被多种语用标准评估。我们在Qwen3-8B-Q8_0（16,640个正式单元，温度=0.0）上进行了四个预先注册、密封的正式实验，测试了单链过早锁定假说的可观察后果：16个假说槽中有15个保持确认状态（12个在实验内Holm控制下拒绝H0，α_fam=0.05；E3_H3降级为描述性状态）。在实验1中，Direct-CoT与MCU在目的性高置信度完成上的差异为25.00 pp（Holm p=1.31239e-05），而NLI-CoT在不间断的非目的性项目上下降-91.25 pp（Holm p=1.81805e-21）。多候选语言化（MCV）在一次调用中产生K=5加权估计，将提示与无加权（MCU）和自加权（MCW）读数区分开。中文（E2）和英语（E3）在NLI-CoT下暴露出中断锚定真实性悖论。在实验4中，MCU-CF使隐含的摩尔句子的感知连贯性比Direct-CoT高26.64 pp（Holm p=0.0006），同时Direct-CF - Direct-CoT = 29.15 pp，MCU-CoT - Direct-CoT = 17.31 pp。一个1,800次调用的OpenAI消融和一个stage="dev"的P16.7跨模型扩展（五个外部模型：4,240个计划/收集单元：4,222个有效，18个格式缺失，0个传输缺失；每片<2%缺失；OpenAI gpt-4o-mini在top_logprobs=20时达到1,000/1,000个有效单元）表明，离散的NLI-CoT和标量Direct-CoT判断在不同模型中分离。确认效应涉及可观察的提示和读数协议；内部过早锁定仍然是一个假说。所有代码、刺激、预先注册的分析计划和验证工具可在https://github.com/asj252/llm-judgment-studies获取。

articles.title: RISA: Recoverable Sparse Attention for Block-Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Block-wise diffusion language models (DLMs) refine multiple tokens in parallel, offering an alternative to token-by-token autoregressive decoding. Their long-context inference, however, remains bottlenecked by memory-bound attention: every denoising step repeatedly reads a growing historical key--value (KV) cache. Directly applying sparse attention does not fully solve this problem, because different queries can select different pages, inflating the block's collective read set, while repeated support construction adds overhead and permanent eviction can discard information needed later. We present RISA, a recoverable sparse-attention method with shared read plans for block-wise DLMs. RISA exploits the fact that historical KV remains fixed within a block while queries evolve across denoising steps. Newly generated history is organized into exact priority and recovery tiers; seed queries then build a protected, bounded read plan whose indices are reused across the block while attention is recomputed with fresh queries and current-block KV. This separates history preservation from repeated reading and amortizes sparse-support construction without changing the backbone or decoder. On DreamReasoner-8B, RISA retains comparable task performance. At 32K, the default configuration speeds up attention by $2.67\times$ and fixed-trajectory requests by $1.36\times$ over dense, and attention speedup reaches $5.53\times$ at 128K. Across eight settings on three models, RISA decodes faster than the tested MAGE, QUEST, and LoSA budgets at matched KL.
articles.titleCn: RISA：适用于块扩散语言模型的可恢复稀疏注意力机制
articles.abstractCn: 块状扩散语言模型（DLMs）并行优化多个标记，为标记逐个自回归解码提供了替代方案。然而，其长上下文推理仍然受限于内存绑定注意力机制：每一步去噪过程都会反复读取不断增长的历史键值（KV）缓存。直接应用稀疏注意力并不能完全解决这个问题，因为不同的查询可以选择不同的页面，导致块的整体读取集膨胀，而重复的支持构建会增加开销，永久驱逐则可能丢弃后续步骤所需的信息。我们提出了RISA，一种具有共享读取计划的块状DLM可恢复稀疏注意力方法。RISA利用了历史KV在块内保持固定而查询在去噪步骤中演变这一事实。新生成的历史被组织成精确优先级和恢复层级；种子查询构建一个受保护的、有界的读取计划，其索引在块内重复使用，而注意力则使用新查询和当前块的KV进行重新计算。这分离了历史保留与重复读取，并在不改变骨干或解码器的情况下摊销了稀疏支持构建的开销。在DreamReasoner-8B上，RISA保持了可比的任务性能。在32K配置下，默认设置比密集注意力快2.67倍，比固定轨迹请求快1.36倍，在128K时注意力加速比达到5.53倍。在三个模型上的八个设置中，RISA在匹配KL下比测试的MAGE、QUEST和LoSA预算解码更快。

articles.title: EGS: A Complementary Safety Framework for Educational LLMs
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong potential for personalized education, but adolescent-facing deployment raises risks of toxic, biased, misleading, or developmentally inappropriate content. We argue that educational safety should move beyond binary refusal: student queries are often ambiguous or curiosity-driven, requiring contextual guidance rather than simple blocking. We introduce the Educational Guardrail System (EGS), a lightweight, model-agnostic runtime framework that complements intrinsic alignment through query moderation, scenario-aware pedagogical guidance, and response moderation. EGS triages inputs by risk level, redirects gray-zone queries with category-specific educational interventions, and audits outputs before delivery. Experiments across general and education-specific benchmarks show that EGS improves moderation performance, refusal quality, and jailbreak robustness across diverse LLMs. These findings suggest that defense-in-depth guardrails can strengthen safety while preserving the pedagogical utility required in educational LLMs. Our code and model weights will be publicly available to support community adoption.
articles.titleCn: EGS：教育式大语言模型的安全补充性框架
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在教育个性化方面具有巨大潜力，但面向青少年的部署存在产生有害、有偏见、误导性或发展不适宜内容的风险。我们认为，教育安全应超越简单的二元拒绝：学生的查询往往模糊不清或出于好奇，需要情境化指导而非简单屏蔽。我们介绍了教育护栏系统（EGS），这是一个轻量级、模型无关的运行时框架，通过查询管理、情境感知的教学指导和响应管理来补充内在一致性。EGS根据风险等级对输入进行分诊，对灰色地带查询进行分类特定的教育干预，并在交付前审核输出。在通用和教育专用基准测试中的实验表明，EGS提升了不同LLMs的审核性能、拒绝质量和越狱鲁棒性。这些发现表明，多层次的护栏可以在保留教育LLMs所需的教学效用同时增强安全性。我们的代码和模型权重将公开提供，以支持社区采用。

articles.title: Fine-Grained Japanese Clinical Named Entity Recognition: A Controlled Comparison of BERT and Open-Weight Large Language Models
articles.abstract: Background: Generative large language models (LLMs) offer an alternative to encoder-based clinical named entity recognition (NER), but their performance on fine-grained Japanese extraction tasks and sensitivity to generation settings remain uncertain. Methods: We compared two fine-tuned BERT-CRF baselines with nine open-weight LLMs on iCorpus, which defines 113 entity categories. The evaluation used 433 sentences from 36 test documents; 1,672 sentences were used for training. LLMs were evaluated using zero-shot prompting with and without JSON Schema constraints and three-seed QLoRA fine-tuning. Fine-tuned models were assessed under different output-token limits, including 900 and larger model-specific limits of 2,600 or 4,096 tokens. Performance was measured using sentence-level label-surface matching with relaxed and exact-surface F1. Results: The highest zero-shot relaxed F1 was 0.337, compared with 0.836-0.841 for the BERT baselines. At the larger output limits, all eight fine-tuned LLMs with at least 13B total parameters exceeded both BERT baselines (relaxed F1, 0.882-0.914; exact-surface F1, 0.840-0.880). Across three-seed means, increasing the output limit improved relaxed F1 by 0.052-0.085, alongside higher recall and fewer length-limited outputs. JSON Schema constraints changed relaxed F1 by -0.014 to +0.008 among seven models outside the two reasoning-oriented configurations, while medical-general model pairs showed no consistent advantage for medical specialization. Conclusions: On this historical Japanese case-report benchmark, task-specific fine-tuning combined with adequate generation capacity was associated with stronger LLM extraction performance. Output-token limits materially affected comparisons with BERT, whereas enforcing output structure alone did not overcome low zero-shot accuracy.
articles.comment: 33 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes appendices with supplementary tables and one supplementary figure
articles.titleCn: 细粒度日语临床命名实体识别：BERT与开源大型语言模型的对比研究
articles.abstractCn: 背景：生成式大型语言模型（LLMs）为基于编码器的临床命名实体识别（NER）提供了一种替代方案，但它们在细粒度日语提取任务上的表现以及生成设置的敏感性仍不确定。方法：我们在定义了113个实体类别的iCorpus上，比较了两个微调的BERT-CRF基线模型与九个开放权重LLMs。评估使用了来自36个测试文档的433个句子；1,672个句子用于训练。LLMs通过带和不带JSON Schema约束的零样本提示以及三种子QLoRA微调进行评估。微调模型在不同输出标记限制下进行评估，包括900和更大的模型特定限制2,600或4,096个标记。性能通过宽松和精确表面F1的句子级标签-表面匹配进行衡量。结果：最高零样本宽松F1为0.337，而BERT基线为0.836-0.841。在更大的输出限制下，所有八个至少有13B总参数的微调LLMs在宽松F1（0.882-0.914）和精确表面F1（0.840-0.880）上均超过了BERT基线。在三个种子的平均值中，增加输出限制使宽松F1提高了0.052-0.085，同时提高了召回率并减少了长度限制的输出。JSON Schema约束在除两个推理导向配置外的七个模型中改变了宽松F1（-0.014至+0.008），而医疗-通用模型对对在医疗专业上没有一致优势。结论：在这个历史日语病例报告基准上，特定任务的微调结合足够的生成能力与更强的LLM提取性能相关。输出标记限制实质上影响了与BERT的比较，而仅强制执行输出结构并未克服低的零样本准确率。

articles.title: SOTA or Luck? The Winner's Curse in LLM Leaderboards
articles.abstract: Public LLM leaderboards guide model evaluation and adoption, yet the reported performance of top-ranked models can be systematically overstated. This leaderboard winner's curse arises because ranking noisy benchmark scores rewards sampling luck alongside genuine ability. The same selection effect can distort scores throughout the leaderboard, a phenomenon we call the rank-induced bias. We develop an $m$-out-of-$N$ bootstrap to correct for this bias. It assumes a fixed model pool with independent, identically distributed bounded tasks while allowing arbitrary within-task correlation among models. Under exact population tiers separated by positive gaps, we prove that the bootstrap reduces $Θ(N^{-1/2})$ ranking bias to expected residual bias $o(N^{-1/2})$. Across 14 benchmarks from 5 benchmark families, the rank-1 adjustments range from approximately 0.09 to 3.86 percentage points. In our SWE-bench Verified snapshot, the tied leaders receive an adjustment of 0.90 percentage points. Such overstatement is large enough to make the apparent winner statistically fragile. Thus, we use the same bootstrap to further quantify the intervals of plausible rank positions for each model and group models into tiers. We establish sufficient conditions for consistent recovery of population tiers. On SWE-bench Verified, this procedure places 13 of 173 models in the leading tier. We combine the score adjustment and rank intervals in the Rank Uncertainty and Leaderboard Evaluation Report (RULER). We validate its finite-sample performance using sample splitting and calibrated simulations, and advocate publishing RULER alongside raw rankings so readers can assess both reported performance and the precision of the ordering. RULER also provides guidance for benchmark design that accounts for selection effects and ranking uncertainty.
articles.titleCn: SOTA还是运气？LLM排行榜中的赢家诅咒
articles.abstractCn: 公共大型语言模型排行榜指导模型评估和采纳，但排行榜上顶尖模型的报告性能可能系统性地被高估。这种排行榜冠军诅咒现象的产生，是因为对噪声基准分数的排名奖励了抽样运气而非真实能力。同样的选择效应会扭曲整个排行榜的分数，我们称之为排名诱导偏差。我们开发了一种m-out-of-N自助法来修正这种偏差。它假设有一个固定的模型池，包含独立同分布的有界任务，同时允许模型间任务内的任意相关性。在精确的、由正差距分隔的总体层级中，我们证明了自助法将Θ(N^{-1/2})的排名偏差减少到期望的残差偏差o(N^{-1/2})。在来自5个基准家族的14个基准测试中，排名第一的调整范围从约0.09到3.86个百分点。在我们的SWE-bench验证快照中，并列领导者获得了0.90个百分点的调整。这种高估足以使显性冠军在统计上变得脆弱。因此，我们使用同样的自助法进一步量化每个模型可能排名的区间，并将模型分层。我们建立了保证总体层级一致恢复的充分条件。在SWE-bench验证中，该流程将173个模型中的13个归入领先层级。我们将分数调整和排名区间结合在排名不确定性及排行榜评估报告（RULER）中。我们通过样本拆分和校准模拟验证了其有限样本性能，并主张将RULER与原始排名一同发布，以便读者可以评估报告性能和排序的精度。RULER还为基准设计提供了指导，考虑选择效应和排名不确定性。
